meta.rule: One prediction per high-confidence pick. Each is hand-written, at least 30 words, and every factual claim in it is a value this session read from the official URC match centre or league table. No injury, selection, weather or transfer information is asserted, because none was read from an official source.
meta.price_band_rule: Written predictions accompany every high-confidence pick. The brief focuses high-confidence generation on fair prices between -250 and +10000; entries marked outside-band are chalk favourites kept for completeness.
